content: Pages requiring attention should be thoroughly reviewed, focusing on the 7,500 most popular pages. When editing a page, it is critical not to overwrite the original content, especially if the page contains extensive differential diagnoses that overlap with a Wikipedia page. Ensure that the template {{SI}} is placed at the top of each page. If there is a navigation box present, the {{SI}} template should be positioned directly beneath it. Generally, {{SI}} must always be at the top of the page. Once I have reviewed and approved a page, I will add the {{CMG}} template. It is important to check the page's history to confirm that there is no extensive differential diagnosis or other text authored by Heather Mangan or Caitlin Harrigan. If such content exists, it should be appropriately integrated into the page.
